about_short_description.short_description: Zentail is a SaaS platform for multi-channel online retailers.

product.name: Product Information Management (PIM)
product.description: A centralized system to clean, organize, and maintain accurate product data for multichannel ecommerce listings.

product.name: Listing Management
product.description: Software that automates product listing creation, error resolution, and attribute mapping across multiple ecommerce marketplaces.

product.name: SMART Types Change Management
product.description: An automated system that adapts product data to comply with sudden changes in marketplace listing requirements.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A tool for real-time inventory tracking, forecasting, and synchronization across multiple sales channels including FBA and FBM.

product.name: Business Analytics
product.description: A reporting system offering custom analytics and insights on sales performance, profit margins, and operational metrics.

product.name: Order Management
product.description: A system that routes multichannel orders to appropriate warehouses and tracks order statuses across sales channels.
